summary:
# Project Summary – EARTHLAB

EARTHLAB – Earth Information Jukebox is an interactive educational website designed to explore our changing planet through science, technology, visualization and sound. The project focuses on important environmental parameters such as global temperature, atmospheric carbon dioxide (CO₂) and Arctic ice changes.

It aims to transform Earth science data into meaningful visual experiences using interactive dashboards, 3D Earth models and dynamic sonification. Users can explore environmental information and understand how our planet changes over time.

The website is designed to make complex scientific information easier to understand, especially for students and educators. By combining scientific data with engaging visual and audio experiences, EARTHLAB encourages environmental awareness and helps people connect with our planet.

**"Explore Earth. Understand Change. Hear Our Planet."
details:
Project Details

Project Name: EARTHLAB – Earth Information Jukebox

Project Category: Earth Science, Environmental Science & Technology

Project Type: Interactive Public Website

Project Description:

EARTHLAB is an interactive web-based platform designed to explore and understand our changing planet. It presents Earth science information through visualizations, interactive dashboards, 3D Earth models and dynamic sonification.

Main Objectives:

  1. To understand Earth's environmental changes.
  2. To explore temperature variations.
  3. To learn about atmospheric CO₂ levels.
  4. To understand Arctic ice changes.
  5. To convert Earth science data into sound.

Key Features:

  • Interactive 3D Earth model.
  • Global temperature information.
  • CO₂ monitoring and visualization.
  • Arctic ice information.
  • Data-to-sound sonification.
  • Interactive Earth science dashboard.
  • Public access through a website link.

Technologies Used:

  • HTML
  • CSS
  • JavaScript
  • 3D visualization technology
  • NASA Earth science data (planned integration)

Target Audience: Students, teachers, researchers and people interested in Earth science.

Expected Outcome:

To create an engaging educational platform that helps people explore Earth's environmental changes through interactive visualizations and sound.

Vision:

"Explore Earth. Understand Change. Hear Our Planet."
